Models: no SPICE model is published for the AP2112K; it is behavioural, from the datasheet (see `pod_supply.py`): it shows dropout and current limiting, not the regulator's own fast transient response, which the datasheet gives as tens of millivolts for a 100 mA step. SS14 as in the relay simulation; its leakage at 25 C (it rises about tenfold by 75 C).

USB inrush: USB 2.0 allows a device to present at most 10 uF at attach (the 50 uC figure). With the 10 uF C1 and C2 first fitted (the `_10u` cases) the pod presented about 22 uF and drew 88 uC; C1 and C2 became 1 uF and 4.7 uF on 2026-10-16 (value changes, same footprints; the AP2112K needs 1 uF on each side).
